about: Scripted clips for the capture tools (Tools/capture/footage.sh, screenshots.sh, trailer.sh; see README). Each plays one hole as a player would: per swing a drag on one ball (side 0 the left green's, 1 the right's) to its aim, Same or Mirror tapped after the drag ("toggle": "before" to tap it first), a moment's hold, then Putt. "aim": "solution" is the hole's stored double ace, struck on the solver's tick when it has movers; otherwise [degrees, power] as the guide takes them (ball A's direction, 0 right and 90 up, and 0-1). "round": "auto" plays it in a round going well (or give the earlier holes' scores). Timings in seconds: lead, and each swing's wait, drag and hold, and tail after the last swing settles; "hint": true shows the hole's hint, "touch": false hides the fingertip. A clip can show a screen instead of a hole, held for its tail: "screen": "trophies" is the Trophy Shelf. "trophies" stages the ones won: per course in order, its cabinet's three shelves of three holes, x a trophy and . an empty slot (courses left out have none). MiniGolf/Game/StoreCapture.swift has the defaults.
